# carlocontext

llms.txt gives information for the LLM to work with.

Personal plugin collection for Grok, Claude Code, and Codex. Built for my own use; intended to be open source. `fastcore` is the first plugin.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent conventions
